title: Midwest Comfort Board
seo_title: Midwest Charcuterie Board for 8–12: Summer Sausage & Colby Jack
description: A Midwest comfort charcuterie board for 8–12: Colby Jack, smoky cheddar, summer sausage, beef sticks, bologna, pickles, horseradish and Club crackers.
hook: Hearty, familiar and proudly unpretentious: summer sausage, Colby Jack and a stack of Club crackers.
why: Colby Jack comes from Wisconsin, so anchoring the board with it is a real regional statement. Summer sausage is the star: smoky, tangy and sliced into thick rounds, with smoked cheddar to echo it.
Bologna and beef sticks belong here without apology, and dill pickles, yellow mustard and horseradish give it the sharp, vinegary bite. Cream cheese on a Club cracker is the classic Midwest moment.

timeline.what: Take out the meats and cheeses.
Slice the summer sausage and cheddar.
Place the cheeses; set out the mustard and horseradish.
Add the meats, pickles and crackers.

faq.q: What's on a Midwest charcuterie board?
faq.a: Colby Jack, smoked cheddar, cream cheese, summer sausage, beef sticks, bologna, jerky, pickles, apples, grapes, mustard, horseradish and Club or Ritz crackers.
Yes. It's one of the most affordable boards in the book at about $35 to $55 for 8 to 12 people.
A cold lager or a Wisconsin-style brandy old fashioned.
